task.text:
[0] The minimum, maximum, and median life expectancy is plotted (10th, 50th, and 90th percentiles, respectively). Young adult C. elegans were transferred to NGM agar plates containing 300 µg mL−1 5-fluorodesoxyuridine (Sigma-Aldrich, München, Germany) to prevent eggs from hatching. In all experiments, the pre-fertile period of adulthood was used as t = 0 for lifespan analysis.

[1] The minimum, maximum, and median life expectancy is plotted (10th, 50th, and 90th percentiles, respectively). Young adult C. elegans were transferred to NGM agar plates containing 300 µg mL−1 5-fluorodesoxyuridine (Sigma-Aldrich, München, Germany) to prevent eggs from hatching. In all experiments, the pre-fertile period of adulthood was used as t = 0 for lifespan analysis.

[2] Gpx4 +/- mice had increased median and mean lifespan and slowed the age-related formation of lymphomas. Gpx4 heterozygous knockout improved apoptotic response to oxidative stress.

[3] 4-month-old C57BL6/129SvJ mice with the single copy of GPX4 were more sensitive to gamma radiation than control mice.

[4] Granulin-absent mice exhibited shortened lifespan and behavioral alterations compared with control. They also had increased ubiquitination in brain tissue and increased microgliosis and astrocytosis.

[5] Grn -/- mice started showing increased mortality after 10 months of age. Granulin deficiency leads to elevated ubiquitination in brain tissues and increased cellular aging, hyperphosphorylation of cellular proteins, including TDP-43, disrupted autophagy-lysosome activity, and IGF1 upregulation.

[6] GSK3A knockout mice exhibited phenotypes of preliminary aging and premature death. At the age of 24 months, only 42% of knockout mice survived vs. 73% of wild-type.

[7] Human GSK3 presents in two isoforms GSK3a and GSK3b, while the fly ortholog of GSK-3, is only Shaggy (Sgg). Ubiquitous overexpression of wild-type sgg significantly shortened lifespan ин 30%, Fig 2C.

[8] Human GSK3 presents in two isoforms GSK3a and GSK3b, while the fly ortholog of GSK-3, is only Shaggy (Sgg). RNAi-mediated reduction in sgg expression using two independent dsRNA-expressing transgenes significantly increased lifespan (Figures 2D and S2F).

[9] Ubiquitous overexpression of constitutively active Sgg (SggS9A) significantly reduced lifespan by 50% (fig. S2E).

Each numbered passage describes one lifespan experiment. For each, report three things using ONLY that passage:
  organism: the model organism studied, one lowercase word
  direction: exactly one of 'increases lifespan', 'decreases lifespan', or 'no change'
  method: how the gene was altered, e.g. gene knockout, overexpression, mutation, knockdown

Output one block per passage, in order, formatted exactly:
[0]
organism: ...
direction: ...
method: ...

Nothing else. If a passage does not state something, write 'unstated'.
